mapper.select: SELECT M.MENU_CODE, M.PARENT_MENU_CODE, M.MENU_NAME, M.MENU_URL, M.MENU_LEVEL, M.SORT_ORDER, NVL(A.READ_AUTH, 'N') AS READ_AUTH, NVL(A.CREATE_AUTH, 'N') AS CREATE_AUTH, NVL(A.UPDATE_AUTH, 'N') AS UPDATE_AUTH, NVL(A.DELETE_AUTH, 'N') AS DELETE_AUTH FROM TB_MENU_MASTER M LEFT JOIN TB_USER_MENU_AUTH A ON A.COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} AND A.USER_ID = #{userId} AND A.MENU_CODE = M.MENU_CODE WHERE M.USE_YN = 'Y' AND M.MENU_GROUP = #{menuGroup} ORDER BY M.MENU_LEVEL, M.SORT_ORDER
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_USER_MENU_AUTH ( COMPANY_CODE, USER_ID, MENU_CODE, READ_AUTH, CREATE_AUTH, UPDATE_AUTH, DELETE_AUTH, UPDATED_BY, UPDATE_DATE ) VALUES ( #{companyCode}, #{userId}, #{menuCode}, #{readAuth}, #{createAuth}, #{updateAuth}, #{deleteAuth}, #{updatedBy}, SYSDATE )
